description_en: Creates a hot parameter rule by calling the CreateHotParamRule operation
description_zh: 调用CreateHotParamRule接口创建热点规则
kebab_example: aliyun ahas-openapi create-hot-param-rule --namespace default --app-name ahas-demo --metric-type 1 --threshold 20.0 --resource handleService --param-idx 1 --stat-duration-sec 1 --control-behavior 0 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateHotParamRule

parameters.help_en: The application name. If the application is an EDAS application, set AppName to the App ID in EDAS. You can view the corresponding ID on the Application Management > Basic Information page in the EDAS console
parameters.help_zh: 应用名，若为EDAS应用，则AppName为EDAS中的App ID，可在EDAS控制台“应用管理>基本信息”中查看对应的ID
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en:
The statistical dimension. Valid values:
0: concurrency
1: pass request count
parameters.help_zh: 统计维度，0表示并发数，1表示通过请求数
parameters.name: metric_type

parameters.help_en: The threshold for each hot parameter in the hot parameter rule. The value must be an integer greater than or equal to 0
parameters.help_zh: 热点规则中针对每个热点参数的阈值，取值范围为≥0的整数
parameters.name: threshold

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the rule. Default value: false
parameters.name: enable

parameters.help_en: The resource name. The name can be up to 1024 characters in length and must correspond to the resource name on the API details page
parameters.help_zh: 资源名。不能超过1024个字符，且该资源名需要与接口详情页面的资源名称相对应
parameters.name: resource

parameters.help_en:
The index of the parameter position, which is the index position of the parameter passed in through instrumentation. This corresponds to the parameter index position in `SphU.entry(xxx,args)`.

For example, in the instrumentation `SphU.entry(resourceName,Entry Type.IN,1,paramA,paramB)`, the parameter index of `paramA` is 0, and the parameter index of `paramB` is 1
parameters.help_zh:
参数位置索引，埋点传入参数的索引位置。对应`SphU.entry(xxx,args)`中的参数索引位置。

例如：`SphU.entry(resourceName,Entry Type.IN,1,paramA,paramB)`埋点中，`paramA`的参数索引是0，`paramB`的参数索引是1
parameters.name: param_idx

parameters.help_en:
The throttling behavior. Valid values:
0: fast failure
2: queuing
parameters.help_zh: 流控效果，0表示快速失败，2表示排队等待
parameters.name: control_behavior

parameters.help_en: The number of burst requests. This parameter is required when the throttling behavior is set to fast failure
parameters.help_zh: 缓冲请求数，流控效果为快速失败时需要设置
parameters.name: burst_count

parameters.help_en: The timeout period, in milliseconds. This parameter is required when the throttling behavior is set to queuing
parameters.help_zh: 超时时间，流控效果为排队等待时需要设置，单位毫秒
parameters.name: max_queueing_time_ms

Code.description_en: The return code or error code

AppName.description_en: The application name. If the application is an EDAS application, set AppName to the App ID in EDAS. You can view the corresponding ID on the Application Management > Basic Information page in the EDAS console
AppName.description_zh: 应用名，若为EDAS应用，则AppName为EDAS中的App ID，可在EDAS控制台“应用管理>基本信息”中查看对应的ID

ControlBehavior.description_en:
The throttling behavior. Valid values:
0: fast failure
2: queuing
ControlBehavior.description_zh: 流控效果，0表示快速失败，2表示排队等待

Enable.description_en: Indicates whether the rule is enabled

MaxQueueingTimeMs.description_en: The timeout period when the throttling behavior is set to queuing, in milliseconds
MaxQueueingTimeMs.description_zh: 流控效果为排队等待时对应的超时时间，单位毫秒

MetricType.description_en:
The statistical dimension. Valid values:
0: concurrency
1: pass request count
MetricType.description_zh: 统计维度，0表示并发数，1表示通过请求数

ParamFlowItemList.description_en: The list of hot parameter exception items

ItemType.description_en: The type of the exception item

ItemValue.description_en: The value of the exception item parameter

Threshold.description_en: The threshold of the exception item

ParamIdx.description_en: The index of the parameter position

Resource.description_en: The resource name. The name can be up to 1024 characters in length and must correspond to the resource name on the API details page
Resource.description_zh: 资源名。不能超过1024个字符，且该资源名需要与接口详情页面的资源名称相对应

RuleId.description_en: The ID of the hot parameter rule

Threshold.description_en: The threshold for a single machine

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
